bibl.title: Sulle tracce di Ammonio: P. Mil. Vogl. I 17, P. Lond. Lit. 30+P. Sijp. 3 e P. Oxy. II 221
bibl.seg: Samuele Coen, Sulle tracce di Ammonio: P. Mil. Vogl. I 17, P. Lond. Lit. 30+P. Sijp. 3 e P. Oxy. II 221.
bibl.note: Examines the abbreviation αμ written on the other face (recto) as the commentary on an unidentified Antimachus' poem preserved by P. Mil. Vogl. I, 17 (= MP3 89; LDAB 221). Through the comparison with other occurrences of the same abbreviation in other paraliterary papyri focusing on epic poetry [P. lit. Lond. + P. Sijp. 3 (= MP3 1039; LDAB 1382); P. Oxy. II, 221 (= MP3 1205; LDAB 1631)], argues that the abbreviation stays for Ἀμμώνιος, and suggests some possible identifications for this unknown personality.
